{{Otheruses|Convocation}}
'''Jedi Convocations''', '''Jedi assemblies''' or '''Jedi conclaves''' were gatherings of members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during [[Time/Legends|times]] of crisis. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were traditionally summoned to the convocation through a [[Force call]]. Convocations were quite rare,<ref name="Dark">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 3]]</ref> as they were often tempting&mdash;if somewhat suicidal&mdash;targets for enemies of the Jedi.

As of [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the great [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] had served as the spokesperson of the Jedi assemblies for six centuries.<ref name="Dark" /> After Master Urr's [[Death/Legends|death]], the tradition of having one of the greatest of the Order act as spokesperson was continued by Jedi Masters [[Nomi Sunrider]]<ref name="Redemption">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 1]]</ref> and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] respectively.<ref name="Swarm">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> Nonetheless, after the [[Conclave at Katarr|Conclave on Katarr]], which was interrupted by [[Darth Nihilus]] [[Force drain/Legends|absorbing]] and killing virtually every living thing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], major Convocations were discontinued.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|146|Jedi Convocation}}</ref>
